thread:
mike: Quick FYI — I've been seeing intermittent TLS handshake failures when services call east-1 -> eu-west-1 proxies. Happens ~1-2x/hour, short spikes. Anyone else?

sara: saw a few alerts from connection-error-rate on the proxy dashboard earlier. not full outage, but elevated 5xx.

oliver: can you paste a sample of the client-side error? openssl or envoy logs?

mike: here's a snippet from the proxy logs around one of the failures:
```
2026-03-18T21:14:02Z proxy-1234 WARN tls_handshake failed: alert handshake_failure
chi: remote_cert_chain_verification: depth=2, error=UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE
```

jana: that "UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE" makes me think of cert chain ordering or missing intermediate. but we recently rolled the regional CA bundles. did the eu pool get the new bundle?

sara: eu-keystore sync job completed ok per job-run-788, but there were RBAC denials last week during rotation window: "keystore.access denied for role=svc-proxy" in audit logs. maybe some certs didn't copy.

mike: good call. audit-bot, can you pull the last 24h keystore transfer logs for eu-west-1?

audit-bot: pulled entries for keystore-sync job id=788: files attempted=24, files succeeded=23, failed=1, error=permission_denied on /eu/ca-chain/intermediate.pem by identity svc-proxy@east-1. See: https://internal.logs/keystore/788 (redacted)

oliver: there we go — missing intermediate in eu store will cause path validation to fail for certain clients that don't fetch AIA. Some proxies (older envoy builds) don't fetch missing chain pieces.

jana: what's the immediate mitigation? can we roll back to previous ca bundle in eu region while we fix transfer?

mike: I'd prefer a staged approach: 1) re-run keystore-sync for that file with explicit RBAC override (temporary role grant) 2) update envoy config to allow fallback to cached chain for 5m and keep metrics 3) add an alert if handshake_failure rate > 0.5% for 15m

sara: RBAC override needs approval from sec-admins. @jana can you request ephemeral grant for svc-proxy keystore access and set a TTL 1h? Put request in tickets.

jana: filing ticket now — sec-admins requested justification and audit note. I've included: "temporary sync for intermediate.pem to restore inter-region TLS path validation; will revoke after successful sync; audit trail retained".

oliver: while that's pending, we should also harden TLS config to avoid downgrade or weak ciphers. Current envoy TLS context includes: 
```yaml
common_tls_context:
  tls_certificates: []
  alpn_protocols: [h2, http/1.1]
  tls_params:
    cipher_suites: "ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256"
    tls_protocols: "TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3"
```
We should remove any RSA-EXPORT or old AES-CBC entries and enforce min TLS1.2+ (we already do) and prefer ECDHE.

mike: agree. Also enable OCSP stapling on edge proxies and ensure cert issuer supports OCSP. That helps catching revoked intermediate issues earlier.

sara: note: enabling OCSP stapling requires build that supports it for our envoy images; infra-oncall previously flagged a perf reg on older versions. We should test on canary first.

jana: once keystore sync is done, I will attach the sync job run id in this thread and revoke the ephemeral grant. audit-bot: please log the RBAC grant and revoke events in the same ticket.

audit-bot: logged RBAC-grant request id=GR-20260318-55, will append revoke event once observed.

mike: one more action: run an inter-region TLS probe from east->eu using openssl to validate chain after fix. use: 
```
openssl s_client -connect proxy.eu-west-1.internal:443 -showcerts -verify 6
```
Expect to see full chain and verify OK. If it still fails, capture s_client -debug output.

oliver: also schedule a canary rollout of updated envoy with stricter cipher list and OCSP enabled behind feature flag for 30m window. We'll monitor latency and handshake_error_rate.

sara: adding prometheus alert tweak: increase retention for tls_handshake_failure_histogram to 72h for debugging.

mike: thanks all. I'll watch the ticket and rerun the probe after jana posts the sync id. Please add any additional triage notes here. :thumbsup:

jana: sync job re-run succeeded at 2026-03-18T22:03:10Z, job id=790. intermediate.pem present. RBAC override revoked at 2026-03-18T22:10:02Z. attaching logs.

mike: re-ran openssl probe, verify OK now. closing incident as mitigated — we'll keep the envoy canary scheduled for tomorrow.

oliver: postmortem note: we should add keystore-sync preflight RBAC smoke check that validates read permissions from target region before rotating CA bundles. I'll draft RFC.

sara: adding follow-up: add KMS access audit tag to the keystore transfer so we can correlate KMS-decrypt events with file writes.

mike: great. thanks team.
